Class GroupedQueryAttention

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.model.llama.GroupedQueryAttention
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attention
public class GroupedQueryAttention extends Object implements Attention
Grouped Query Attention (GQA). GQA is a highly efficient transformer attention mechanism that bridges the gap between traditional Multi-Head Attention (MHA) and Multi-Query Attention (MQA). By grouping sets of query heads to share a single Key and Value head, GQA drastically reduces memory usage during inference while maintaining model quality.

KV activations are stored in a shared KvCachePool managed by the inference engine (e.g. smile-serve), enabling radix-tree prefix reuse across requests instead of allocating a private maxBatchSize × maxSeqLen buffer per layer.

    • replaceProjections

      public void replaceProjections(LinearOp wq, LinearOp wk, LinearOp wv, LinearOp wo)
      Replaces projection ops with quantized backends (shard-then-pack already applied). Unregisters and frees dense LinearLayer shells so their GPU storage is released before KV pool sizing.
      Parameters:
      wq - query projection op.
      wk - key projection op.
      wv - value projection op.
      wo - output projection op.
